name: Milk Bikis
ingredients: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA) (63%), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, MILK PRODUCTS (4%) SWEETENED CONDENSED PARTLY SKIMMED MILK & MILK SOLIDS), INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, RAISING AGENTS [503(1) &500 IODISED SALT, EMULSIFIERS (322) & 471), NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL (MILK & VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, CALCIUM SALT, VITAMINS AND POTASSIUM IODATE. (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK AND SOYA.
